info.name: SS-6344 Brightsun automatic Search and Match
info.description: Malformed token and offer IDs on Result/book/create. Search is setup only. Match segments, checkedBaggage and before exchange/refund permissions. Service performs recovery; collection does not manually re-search. Booking price retry retained.

exec: if (!Array.isArray(data.results) || !data.results.length) { pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); throw new Error('No selectable Search setup inventory'); }

request.description: POST selected Search solution unchanged; prepare booking from the fresh Result response.

exec: throw new Error('Run Search first: no selected solution is available.');

function corrupt(info,mutation){const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(info));if(mutation==='token')copy.token='INVALID_TEST_TOKEN';else{for(const k of ['optionKeys','outboundKey','inboundKey']){if(!Object.hasOwn(copy,k))throw new Error('Required mutation field unavailable: '+k);copy[k]=Array.isArray(copy[k])?copy[k].map((_,i)=>'SS6344-MALFORMED-OFFER-'+i):'SS6344-MALFORMED-OFFER';}}return copy;}

if (pm.iterationData.get('endpoint') === 'result') { const body = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('brightsun_selected_solution')); body.keys.brightsun = corrupt(body.keys.brightsun, pm.iterationData.get('mutation')); pm.collectionVariables.set('brightsun_selected_solution', JSON.stringify(body)); }

function corrupt(info,mutation){const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(info));if(mutation==='token')copy.token='INVALID_TEST_TOKEN';else{for(const k of ['optionKeys','outboundKey','inboundKey']){if(!Object.hasOwn(copy,k))throw new Error('Required mutation field unavailable: '+k);copy[k]=Array.isArray(copy[k])?copy[k].map((_,i)=>'SS6344-MALFORMED-OFFER-'+i):'SS6344-MALFORMED-OFFER';}}return copy;}
if(pm.response.code===200) pm.test('SS-6344: Segments and matching fare flags retained', () => pm.expect(matching(data)).to.deep.equal(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('matching_baseline'))));
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('booking_body')) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('No fresh booking body: run Search and Result first'); }
if (!pm.variables.get('booking_username') || !pm.variables.get('booking_password')) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set local Basic Auth environment variables'); }
pm.test('SS-6341: Updated price equals 422 response price', () => pm.expect(updated.trip.total_price).to.equal(data.data.response.total_price));

pm.test('SS-6344: Baggage and before penalties match',()=>{const f=data.additionalInfo.fare;pm.expect({checkedBaggage:f.checkedBaggage,exchange:f.exchange,refund:f.refund}).to.deep.equal(baseline.fare);for(const [t,p]of baseline.before)pm.expect(f[t==='ex'?'exchange':'refund']).to.equal(p);});
